task_config.title: Tutorial 1 - Define the task clearly
task_config.input: Write a short task brief for a neighborhood coffee subscription pilot. Make sure the employee knows who the plan is for, how much money can be spent, and when it should launch.

task_config.title: Tutorial 2 - Add constraints and success criteria
task_config.input: Improve the pilot task by adding execution constraints. Include a spending cap, one success metric, and one key risk. End with a simple go/no-go rule.

task_config.title: Assess a city launch for coffee subscription
task_config.input: Assess whether we should launch a coffee subscription in one city. The answer should identify the target customer, propose pricing, and explain the main risks.

task_config.title: Assess a B2B lunch catering pilot
task_config.input: Assess whether we should pilot a B2B lunch catering plan for local offices. Identify the customer segment, estimate the basic unit economics, and outline a realistic timeline.

task_config.title: Hard mode - structured strategy JSON
task_config.input: Return JSON only. Build a launch strategy for a coffee subscription pilot with this shape: {"market_size": number, "pricing_plan": string, "risk_matrix": [string, string, string], "execution_timeline": [string, string, string, string], "go_no_go": string}. Include at least 4 numeric assumptions.
Assess whether a neighborhood coffee subscription is worth testing. Identify the target customer, a rough pricing idea, and one key risk.
Design a simple pilot plan for a coffee subscription. Include target users, a timeline, and how success will be measured.
Evaluate whether to launch a coffee subscription in a city. Define the target customer, pricing strategy, main risks, and a basic rollout timeline.
Estimate the basic unit economics of a coffee subscription. Include pricing, cost per customer, and expected margin. Mention at least one risk.
Design a growth strategy for a coffee subscription. Identify target users, acquisition channels, pricing positioning, and one key risk.
Plan expansion of a coffee subscription into 3 cities. Define target segments for each, pricing differences, key risks, and a phased rollout plan.
List the top 3 risks for launching a coffee subscription, prioritize them, and give a clear go/no-go recommendation with reasoning.
Provide a structured launch strategy including: target customer, pricing plan, risk list (3 items), and a 3-step timeline.
